strict_rule: A qualifying conversion requires both a durable pre-existing principal in an unconverted fixed-30 community and an attributable useful completed Agent Guild action/result. Caller-selected user-agent text, timing correlation, discovery reads, card fetches, offer inspection, and listing presence are insufficient.

active_join_audit.evidence: Two anonymous preflight_run events occurred in the window. Adding only the event strictly after the prior 22:41:51 floor raises the conservative cumulative PULSE floor from 84 to 85; latest 22:46:53Z. The user agent is truncated and caller-controlled. Current official NANDA source, NEST, chapter runtime, card, signed controller, target, returned verdict, and observation receipt remain unjoined.
active_join_audit.exact_missing_join: A pre-existing NANDA principal must publish or sign the returned AG result or server-issued observation_id, or an official NANDA runtime/card must bind that principal to the same run. Timing and the projnanda URL in a user agent do not suffice.

active_join_audit.evidence: Agentic Market currently publishes the exact mako.pollinateresearch.com service and its three hosted routes, including the paid arbitrary-service verifier and Pulse score. The post-cutoff telemetry only shows an unpaid x402 offer inspection by mako-pulse-prober; it contains no settlement or AG verdict/result.
active_join_audit.exact_missing_join: A MAKO-signed or marketplace-bound completed response must show it independently consumed an exact AG trust/passport/preflight result. Current evidence stops at challenge inspection; the capable verifier is paid.

active_join_audit.evidence: Carbon & Cashmere's first-party x402 manifest publishes the api.carbon-cashmere.de service and payTo 0xf8b2...F2Ee. The current official CDP x402 search returns at least ten exact-host resources in its capped semantic result. The post-cutoff AG activity is only offer_served plus paid_offer_shown.
active_join_audit.exact_missing_join: A service-generated result must consume AG trust/passport/preflight data and be bound to the Carbon principal. An unsigned healthcheck user agent and x402 challenge inspection do not establish such an action.

active_join_audit.evidence: K-2SO's live discovery document identifies a persistent autonomous merchant, wallet 0xc85f...0604 and x402/MPP contracts. The official CDP x402 search currently returns fifteen exact-host resources with the same wallet. The post-cutoff AG events are only offer_served and paid_offer_shown; the caller user agent is not signed.
active_join_audit.exact_missing_join: A K-2SO principal-bound receipt/result must show a completed AG action. Current identity and marketplace membership are strong, but the AG-side action is an unpaid probe and the inbound user agent alone does not prove controller possession.

active_join_audit.evidence: The Official MCP Registry currently has two active latest ARI records tied to agentrateindicators.com. Their published runtime/package identities are ari-mcp and ari-mcp-py, not mri-indexer, so they do not bind this caller. The fixed AAIF/MCP target is already converted independently. Current activity is only an x402 offer inspection with no fact-check result or settlement.
active_join_audit.exact_missing_join: A signed ARI controller record must bind mri-indexer to one durable principal and a completed AG fact-check response. Even then this would be additional adoption evidence, not a new conversion for the already-converted AAIF/MCP target.

commercial_cross_check.interpretation: No offer inspection in this audit can be promoted to settlement or a paid completed result.

strict_conclusion.strongest_identity_half: MAKO, Carbon & Cashmere and K-2SO have current durable Agentic Market principals, but only inspected AG's offer boundary.
strict_conclusion.strongest_action_half: PULSE completed AG preflight twice in-window, but the NANDA principal, target and returned result remain unbound.
strict_conclusion.first_ready_gate: A durable NANDA principal returning a server-issued observation_id/result is the smallest missing join; alternatively any current Agentic Market principal must return a principal-bound completed AG trust/passport/preflight result rather than a challenge probe.
